tax: Contribuții de asigurări sociale de stat obligatorii (angajator)
statute: Legea nr. 489/1999 privind sistemul public de asigurări sociale, anexa nr. 1 pct. 1.1 (24 % for private-sector employers, no ceiling)
dated: Legea nr. 489/1999 as in force 01.01.2025 (edition of 31.01.2024), read on legis.md in a browser on 26 November 2026 (doc_id=139810), anexa nr. 1 is the .docx the page links
unsupported: budget-funded employers (29 %), special working conditions (32 % / 39 %), farm employers (18 % + 6 % from the state budget) and IT-park residents (Legea nr. 77/2016) are not distinguished

tax: Prima de asigurare obligatorie de asistență medicală (angajat)
statute: Legea nr. 304/2024 art. 4 alin. (1) (9,0 % of wages), Legea nr. 1593/2002 anexa nr. 1 pct. 2, art. 6
dated: Legea nr. 304/2024 (doc_id=146464), Legea nr. 303/2024 (doc_id=146462) and Legea nr. 1593/2002 (doc_id=144917) as in force 01.01.2025, read on legis.md in a browser on 26 November 2026
unsupported: the income-tax model does not deduct the premium, so the 1100 income tax on wages is too high by 12 % of the premium
employees of IT-park residents pay no premium (Legea nr. 1593/2002 art. 4 (1¹)), which a household line cannot show

tax: Fixed contributions of the self-employed (social contribution and health premium)
statute: Legea nr. 303/2024 art. 3 alin. (1) (20 518 lei), Legea nr. 489/1999 anexa nr. 1 pct. 1.6, Legea nr. 304/2024 art. 4 alin. (2) (12 636 lei), Legea nr. 1593/2002 anexa nr. 2 pct. 1 lit. b)
dated: Legea nr. 304/2024 (doc_id=146464), Legea nr. 303/2024 (doc_id=146462) and Legea nr. 1593/2002 (doc_id=144917) as in force 01.01.2025, read on legis.md in a browser on 26 November 2026
unsupported: an adult with self-employment income and no wages is taken as a founder of an individual enterprise, a default of the model (the reason for grade B)
pensioners, persons with disabilities, liberal professions (27 772 lei) and patent holders are not distinguished
an adult with both wages and self-employment income is not decided, nothing is booked
the reductions of the fixed health premium for early payment are not modelled
